notes.title: War Diaries 9 - “Blood for Goods”
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BhgFpfgnzqs;full][/previewyoutube]

In the early stages of WWII Germany vehemently believed in their greatness. However, nothing lasts forever.
Surely, heads of the German government would not even dare to imagine that just a few years later, on April 25, 1944, Adolf Eichmann would be forced to make the Allies a most unimaginable offer - to trade the lives of 1 million Hungarian Jews for 10,000 trucks, coffee, and tea.
Germany was so exhausted by the war at that point, deprived of goods and manpower, that they resorted to insane desperation.
Watch the latest episode of "War Diaries" and find out more!

notes.title: Facts about the Second World War - Did you know…?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22254111/7da379d8c0f143b81d8f8277641c097a06f1ef24.png[/img]

In 1942, at a Lake Wannsee villa, decisions related to the so-called "final solution to the Jewish question" were made.
When the fate of many is decided, it typically doesn't happen in evil caves or obscure bars, like in the movies. It's decided over a nice lunch, at conferences in opulent places. Doesn't it feel more evil this way?

notes.title: It's been a year since we revealed "War Mongrels"...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22254111/424ef4eb96208200ebcea0ae0a05b713c6401128.jpg[/img]

It's been a year since we revealed "War Mongrels". The game's setting is meant to feature an underrepresented, important part of WWII history and showcase the dangers of any ideology.
Originally, War Mongrels was supposed to be revealed at gamescom 2020. Together with our friends, Caliban, we prepared an awesome announcement concert, which was cancelled 10 minutes before the start.

What War Mongrels also showcases is that no matter the times, it's easy to become affected by ignorance and hypocrisy. And since ignorance is bliss, we're hoping that today, one year later, there are people who're feeling happy and fulfilled having screwed us last year. On this unfortunate anniversary we wish them consistency and resolve in their beliefs.

What we're ultimately trying to say with all this is THANK YOU for your continuous support for DC and War Mongrels. We're a small team and it's thanks to you that we can continue to make games we believe in and overcome obstacles like the one a year ago.

You'll be able to judge WM for yourselves on October 19 and we can't wait to see what y'all think!

notes.content:

notes.title: War Diaries - Part 6
notes.content:
Two of the main characters in “War Mongrels” represent the so-called "Silent Unseen" (Polish “Cichociemni”). These were special forces, trained in Great Britain and formed by Polish men, sent to perform deadly and dangerous tasks. They were secretly dropped over occupied Poland to aid the resistance, bring know-how, money, and equipment. BTW: the last of these heroes lives. His name is Aleksander Tarnawski, he is a citizen of our Gliwice, and is now exactly 100 years old.
Enjoy the next episode of “War Diaries”!

notes.title: We are no dead!
notes.content:
Salut!

We know that you would like to hear from us about ISD plans... and maybe you will ...someday ;)
As for now we are focused on Ancestors Legacy release. 
We want to show you that we didn't get softer at all! 
We are still Destructive Creations and we wanted to show, that RTS games can be dark and brutal, as today we get overwhelmed with colourful games designed to be PEGI-12 at most.

Ancestors Legacy IS dark and brutal, as it tries to reflect medieval times as they really were. 
Apart from strategy and tactics, this game is primarly about CRUSHING SKULLS OF YOUR ENEMIES!

No unicorns and sorcerers, just blood, mud, sorrow and death!

History is written by the conquerors!

We added few screenshots to show you combat and the level of brutality, especially for Hatred community! 

Let us know in comments if you want more!

notes.title: IS Defense – fight for NATO and win prizes
notes.content:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=750861265 You can take part in a global contest with unique awards and a prize pool worth of $600! We are also happy to announce that IS Defense is heading for Xbox One this year!

You can buy IS Defense for 5,99 USD during the biggest IS Defense contest.

The contest will start on 29th of August and end on September 26th. The rules are simple – players must achieve the highest score during the entire contest lasting 7 days. Additionally every week 3 players with the highest score on the Sicilian Shores map will be awarded a Steam-key to Hatred game and a t-shirt. After a four week struggle creators of IS Defense will present three players with the best results for the whole month. Gold, silver, and bronze medalists will be awarded with additional awards – replicas of military gear used by NATO troops.

The contest results will be announced on the official IS Defense Facebook page shortly after the end of a full week of struggle - on 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th September.

Destructive Creations will publish a comprehensive list of 12 best players and three medalists – the winners of the whole contest – on 27th September.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
A bit bigger update than yesterday's. This time we've fixed a few things as well as added those you requested. Here we go:
[olist]
[*]Timer is fixed (again) and now it properly displays hours instead of hundreds of minutes - easier to read
[*]Score above 100k will now properly fit into it's designed area
